description: Fuentes para análisis aproximado. Las capas WMTS de Trek son imágenes renderizadas; el cálculo métrico usa DEM numéricos.

moon.name: Luna

dem.title: LRO LOLA Global Lunar Digital Elevation Model, 118 m
dem.notes: La etiqueta del producto define un factor de escala de 0.5 para los valores enteros almacenados. Producto global; ocupa varios GB.

trek_visual_layers: LRO LOLA South Pole Illumination / PSR

additional_data.illumination: Moon Trek / LRO LOLA illumination products or a time-series illumination raster
additional_data.albedo: LRO Diviner reflectance or another documented lunar reflectance product
additional_data.craterFree: LROC crater/rock hazard product at a stated spatial resolution
additional_data.soilStability: A documented geotechnical proxy raster; do not infer it from the DEM alone
additional_data.ice: A documented ice-potential raster derived from relevant LRO observations
additional_data.iceConfidence: A separate confidence raster for the ice-potential estimate

dem.title: MGS MOLA Global DEM, 463 m
dem.notes: DEM global referido al areoide; el producto completo ocupa aproximadamente 2 GB.

additional_data.illumination: A documented solar-illumination raster for the selected season and mission duration
additional_data.albedo: A documented TES or other calibrated reflectance product
additional_data.craterFree: CTX/HiRISE crater, rock and hazard information at a stated spatial resolution
additional_data.soilStability: A documented thermal-inertia or geotechnical proxy raster
additional_data.iceConfidence: A separate confidence raster for the ice-potential estimate
